items.title: GitHub Hardens npm and Actions Defaults, Drawing Debate over Delays versus Signing
items.blurb: GitHub consolidated the npm and Actions changes it shipped from March to July 2026 against supply chain attacks, several of which alter defaults rather than add options.

items.title: npm Staged Publishing Available, Adding a Human Approval Step before Packages Go Live
items.blurb: npm has introduced staged publishing for Node.js, requiring maintainer approval before a version is installable. Versions are queued and must pass a two-factor authentication challenge for release.

items.title: Web Security is Too Hard
items.blurb: It started innocently enough. I saw a tweet about a new product offering from one of my favorite companies, Cloudflare. Neat! I clicked through to the site and there it is: And huzzah!, my preferred handle, @ericlaw is still available.

items.title: Bringing Post-Quantum Cryptography to Java LTS Releases
Keyv and friends compromised in active Shai-Hulud supply chain attack
items.blurb: Mini Shai-Hulud malware was injected into keyv and eight related npm packages on August 4, 2026 after an attacker compromised the maintainer's GitHub account
